notes.title: Issued discount coupon deadline for TITAN SLAYER II
notes.content:
We have issued discount coupon for following conditions
・Issued [b]15% off[/b] coupon for those who had TITAN SLAYER I
・Issued [b]10% off[/b] coupon for those who owns TITAN SLAYER II DEMO

Deadline for issued coupon will be until Tuesday March 19 18:00 in PST
Don’t miss this opportunity to get the latest [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/906770/TITAN_SLAYER/]TITAN SLAYER Ⅱ[/url]

notes.title: “TITAN SLAYER II” EARLY ACCESS RELEASE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581010/e7c662972f0acc7c7ea94a29470be9fa73f75eae.png[/img]
We are very happy to announce that the “TITAN SLAYER II” is now on site as Early Access!!
We had also launched “TITAN SLAYER ULTRA PACK” which is a better deal if you purchase “TITAN SLAYER” and ““TITAN SLAYER II” as a set.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581010/79709afa8e971a089a0de9382fc29dc698175cb2.png[/img]
“TITAN SLAYER ULTRA PACK” is limited time sales only for 2 weeks!! Get it before its too late!

Your feedback and comments are always welcome to improve this game.
Let’s make the great game together!

notes.title: We are about to launch “TITAN SLAYER II” in Early Access.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581010/27af088c0af9f311e7742558d6458b53a252e34b.png[/img]

We are about to launch “[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/906770/TITAN_SLAYER/]TITAN SLAYER II[/url]” in Early Access.
And also would like to introduce “TITAN SLAYER ULTRA PACK” for those who haven’t played the game yet.  
If you get our TITAN SLAYER with this pack during this Halloween sales period, you can purchase our “TITAN SLAYER II” in discounted price.

With the power of Unreal Engine 4, we can give you the best VR experience you ever had before.
We are planning to update regularly with more fields and weapons.
Your feedback and comments are always welcome to improve this game.
Let’s make the great game together!
